assessment: This fundamental work by Ziolkowski et al provides an exceptional advance in our understanding of the physiological sense of touch by directly perfoming in vivo patch-clamp recordings from vertebrate skin mechanoreceptor terminals. The provided evidence is compelling, overcoming a long-existing technical challenge and providing an experimental model to investigate the neuronal response to mechanical stimulation at the site of force detection that is of broad interest to physiologists, neuroscientists and biophysicists working on mechanoreceptors and mechanically activated ion channels.
